description: Download TikTok videos (clean or watermarked), audio, covers, slideshow frames, and post metadata. Clean MP4 files are downloaded inside a browser session and re-hosted in Apify Key-Value Store; watermarked/direct assets can be re-hosted or returned as expiring CDN URLs.

assetTypes.description: Assets to produce for each post. 'video' = MP4; 'audio' = TikTok sound; 'cover' = cover image; 'slideshow' = ordered photo frames; 'metadata' = post/author/stats/music row.
assetTypes.title: Asset Types

downloadToKv.description: Store watermarked video, audio, cover, and slideshow files in the run's Key-Value Store and return stable kvsUrl links. Clean video is always stored because its source URL is session-bound. Set false to return expiring CDN URLs only.
downloadToKv.title: Download Files to Apify Key-Value Store

maxConcurrency.description: Number of posts processed in parallel (1-3). Embed requests are retried with backoff when TikTok rate-limits them.
maxConcurrency.title: Max Concurrency

maxFileSizeMb.description: Per-file size cap. Files above the cap produce a 'too_large' status row instead of a partial download.
maxFileSizeMb.title: Max File Size (MB)

maxItems.description: Maximum number of unique posts to process. Inputs beyond the cap receive a 'limit_reached' status row.
maxItems.title: Max Posts

postUrls.description: TikTok post URLs or IDs. Accepts /@user/video/ID, /@user/photo/ID, /video/ID, /photo/ID, embed URLs (/embed/v2/ID), vm.tiktok.com / vt.tiktok.com / /t/ short links, m.tiktok.com/v/ID.html, and bare numeric post IDs. Duplicates are processed once.
postUrls.title: Post URLs

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. The actor uses a direct connection by default and does not require a proxy. Use this only if you want to route requests through Apify Proxy.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration

quality.description: Target clean-video quality. 'best' sorts by resolution first, then bitrate. Watermarked copies are single-resolution.
quality.title: Video Quality

videoVariant.description: 'clean' = no-watermark MP4 (requires a same-page browser session and is always re-hosted). 'watermarked' = logo copy, usable as an expiring CDN URL. 'both' = one row per variant.
videoVariant.title: Video Variant

title: TikTok Downloader API Input
